# XMLFastParser & Xml2Txt

> High-performance Java XML parsing library and CLI text conversion tool. Designed for extreme throughput using Finite State Machine (FSM), TreeGraph hierarchy, statistical speculative skipping, and fault-tolerant streaming.

## Project Overview

- Repository: https://github.com/oodwebserv01/XMLFastParser
- License: MIT License
- Language: Java (JDK 8+)
- Architecture: Single-threaded/Multithreaded FSM-based XML Parsing

## Key Components

1. **xmlFastParser (Core Library)**
   - Custom state machine bypassing heavy DOM/SAX overhead.
   - TreeGraph model for light structural memory representation.
   - Statistical speculative skipping to fast-forward uninteresting XML blocks.
   - Fault-tolerant parser capable of recovering from malformed or incomplete XML tags.

2. **Xml2Txt (Application)**
   - Command-line tool to strip XML tags and flatten hierarchy into structured plain text.
   - Direct ZIP/Archive streaming support without temporary disk extraction.

## Performance Benchmarks

- **Dataset**: 10 GB Raw XML Data (compressed inside 5 GB ZIP archive).
- **Processing Time**: ~165 seconds (single-threaded execution).
- **Environment**: Standard JVM settings without native JNI bindings.

## Repository Structure

- `java/xmlFastParser/`: Source code for the core XML parser library.
- `java/Xml2Txt/`: Source code for the CLI converter application.
- `README.md`: Setup instructions, technical details, and full API usage.
- `LICENSE`: Open-source MIT License.

## Usage Guidelines for AI Agents

- Refer to `java/xmlFastParser/` when analyzing parsing algorithms, FSM state handling, or memory-skipping mechanics.
- Refer to `java/Xml2Txt/` when evaluating streaming file input/output, ZIP entry decompression, or CLI parsing logic.
